author: maggieroseadvocate
caption: Collagen is what gives skin its structure, firmness, and bounce. And while we naturally make less of it as we age, there are ways to support what we have and encourage new production: - Vitamin C: An essential cofactor your body actually needs to synthesize and stabilize collagen. - Sun protection: UV exposure activates enzymes that break down collagen and contributes to photoaging. Protecting your skin helps preserve the collagen you already have. - Collagen generators: I use BioSil, a stabilized form of orthosilicic acid (ch-OSA). Human studies suggest it can support the body’s own collagen production and improve measures of skin elasticity and texture. - Red light therapy: Specific wavelengths of red/NIR light can influence cellular signaling and fibroblast activity, with studies showing improvements in collagen density and skin appearance. Wavelength and dose matter, which is why I prioritize quality devices. - Adequate protein: Collagen is a protein. Your body needs amino acids, especially glycine, proline  and lysine, as the raw materials to build it. BONUS: I recently learned from a holistic esthetician that microneedling can help with collagen production by up to 400%! I'm starting that journey with her now.  #collagen #healthyaging #skinhealth

author: thebeautydoctrine
caption: ⚠️ What's hiding in your collagen? Not all collagen supplements are created equal, and some may contain contaminants you would never expect in a product marketed for health and longevity. Heavy metals like lead, cadmium, arsenic, and mercury can find their way into supplements through environmental contamination, sourcing, and manufacturing practices. And when you're taking something every single day, even low levels of contamination deserve scrutiny. This is why I always encourage consumers to look beyond the marketing claims and investigate ingredient sourcing, manufacturing standards, and independent third-party testing. I love Ancient Bliss Marine Collagen, but choosing a collagen supplement should never be just about the collagen itself. Purity, transparency, and quality control matter just as much. And remember, collagen is not a shortcut to younger skin. Your body needs adequate protein, vitamin C, healthy metabolic function, and the right biological conditions to build and maintain collagen. ✨ Functional Beauty means supporting your skin from the inside out, without compromising your long-term health. 🛒 Shop Ancient Bliss through my TikTok Shop. #TikTokShopBlackFriday #bestcollagen #TikTokShopFinds #MarineCollagen #antiaging
